The issuer demonstrates strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 19% ($749M) and substantial equity of over $21 billion, but its balance sheet exhibits a tight liquidity profile with a current ratio of 0.79 ($5.68B in current assets against $7.15B in current liabilities) and a highly leveraged capital structure (total liabilities representing approximately 73% of total assets). This combination of solid, highly profitable operations and a large asset base, offset by short-term liquidity pressures and significant overall leverage, is characteristic of a solid investment-grade credit. 

DECISION: BBB-
